name: zinput_bindgroup_list_add_group
description: zInput::BindGroupList_AddGroup allocates a bind-group record, stores the title, appends it to the global bind-group vector, grows storage when needed, and returns the previous group count.
known_limits: VC5SP3 zinput_bindmap_context under profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_gx_gr_facs currently fails this function with 501 unmasked mismatches after 68 relocation bytes and 12 trimmed VC5 NOPs, BN size 579 vs VC5 size 320.

Reconstruction remains limited because Binary Ninja HLIL preserves VC5SP3 EH state, vector insertion template branches, and an allocator-byte construction artifact; assembly comments document the effective source-level append and reallocation behavior. Owner-level tier S remains blocked by sibling bind-group default setup drift.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x42a070 validates previous-count return, allocation of a 20-byte zInput_BindGroupInfo, CString/title assignment, empty command-id vector initialization, in-place append when capacity permits, and vector reallocation when capacity is exhausted.

The dependency frontier has accepted source/provider coverage for allocator/delete, CString provider operations, zUtil vector helper provider operations, StdPtrVector::ClearNoOpDestroy, and zInput_BindGroupInfoVec::Count.

The native bind-group smoke verifies empty-list insertion returns index 0, second insertion returns index 1, group count/title lookup after growth, vector clear cleanup, and the default-bindings path that appends multiple bind groups through both growth and available-capacity cases.
